claim_en: THE FIRST FRUITS BROUGHT IN A BASKET AND THE DECLARATION: WHEN YOU COME INTO THE LAND, POSSESS IT AND DWELL IN IT, TAKE FROM THE FIRST OF ALL THE FRUIT OF THE GROUND IN A BASKET TO THE PLACE; SAY TO THE PRIEST 'I DECLARE THIS DAY THAT I HAVE COME INTO THE LAND HE SWORE'; HE SETS THE BASKET BEFORE THE ALTAR; RECITE 'A WANDERING ARAMEAN WAS MY FATHER' TO 'NOW I HAVE BROUGHT THE FIRST OF THE FRUIT'; SET IT DOWN, BOW, REJOICE WITH THE LEVITE AND THE STRANGER. The Sifrei: entering and settling before the duty (297:1-3); the species by the two loaves' analogy (297:4-5 — Bikkurim 1:3); a cluster or a grape, fruit not wine, whose soil (297:6-10); the basket a vessel, Shiloh and the eternal house (298); no ingratitude, once a year, proselytes, slaves and Trans-Jordan (299 — Bikkurim 1:4-6, 1:8); the trays and baskets, the waving, no altar no first fruits, stolen or unclean (300 — Bikkurim 3:8, 2:4); the recital in the holy tongue (301:1 — Sotah 7:2-3), Laban the Aramean (301:3), the seventy, the Haggadah's rows, the plagues by pairs (301:4-24); this place the Temple, milk and honey, the early fig, who brings and does not recite, the two settings, the joy, the wife's property (301:25-37 — Bikkurim 1:1-2, 1:10, 3:1, 3:4, 3:7; Terumot 11:3); 63:9 the offering of the hand. Onkelos: the sala, His Shekhinah at the place, Laban sought to destroy my father, the toil revealed.

claim_en: THE THIRD YEAR'S TITHE GIVEN AND THE CONFESSION: WHEN YOU FINISH TITHING ALL YOUR PRODUCE IN THE THIRD YEAR, THE YEAR OF THE TITHE, GIVE IT TO THE LEVITE, THE STRANGER, THE ORPHAN AND THE WIDOW THAT THEY EAT WITHIN YOUR GATES AND ARE SATISFIED; SAY BEFORE THE LORD 'I HAVE REMOVED THE HOLY FROM THE HOUSE AND GIVEN IT BY ALL YOUR COMMANDMENT; I HAVE NOT TRANSGRESSED NOR FORGOTTEN; NOT EATEN OF IT IN MY MOURNING NOR REMOVED IT IN UNCLEANNESS NOR GIVEN OF IT FOR THE DEAD; LOOK DOWN FROM YOUR HOLY HABITATION AND BLESS'. The Sifrei: the removal at Passover's last day of the fourth and seventh years, the seventh year exempt, one tithe (302:1; 109:1-5 — Maaser Sheni 5:6); each his share, till satisfied — half a kav of wheat or a kav of barley (303:1-2 — Peah 8:5); the confession in any language, the tithes' order, the kinds, the blessing (303:3-12 — Maaser Sheni 5:10-14; Peah 1:1); mourning, uncleanness, the dead — R. Eliezer and R. Akiva (303:13-17); 72:5 grounds the warning at 12:17; the chosen house, look down (303:18-20). Onkelos: the holy of the tithe, the Memra received.

Onkelos: the beloved people, highest over the peoples.
